normalization_plan.reason: userAddress only carries meaning as the input signer/relayer-target of executeMetaTransaction; fold the parameter into that function node.
functionSignature is the raw calldata replay payload of executeMetaTransaction; fold into the function node.
sigR is only a signature component consumed by executeMetaTransaction/verify; fold into the calling function node.
sigS is only a signature component consumed by executeMetaTransaction/verify; fold into the calling function node.
sigV is only a signature component consumed by executeMetaTransaction/verify; fold into the calling function node.
metaTx is a transient in-memory struct inside executeMetaTransaction and has no independent semantics.
success is the boolean result of the low level self-call and belongs to that unsafe operation.
returnData is the raw bytes returned by the low level self-call and belongs to that unsafe operation.
sender is the debit side of _transfer and is not a standalone entity.
recipient is the credit side of _transfer and is not a standalone entity.
amount is the value moved by _transfer and is consumed by the balance arithmetic.
senderBalance is a cached read of _balances[sender] feeding the debit arithmetic, merge into the balance subtraction unsafe operation.
sender selects the allowance and balance slots of transferFrom only.
recipient is only the destination of the delegated _transfer call.
amount drives both the delegated transfer and the allowance decrement in transferFrom.
currentAllowance is the cached minuend of the allowance subtraction, merge into that arithmetic unsafe operation.
_from is only forwarded into the protection hook and has no independent role.
_to is only forwarded into the protection hook and has no independent role.
_amount is only forwarded into the protection hook and has no independent role.
_holders is the iteration source of the revoke loop inside revokeBlocked.
_revokeTo is the beneficiary of the seized balances and is defined by that unsafe transfer operation.
pool is a transient cache of getLiquidityPool() inside revokeBlocked.
holder is the argument of the external isBlocked query and the source of the seizure, merge into that unsafe operation.
i is a plain loop counter inside revokeBlocked with no standalone semantics.
_holders is the iteration source of the unblock loop.
pool is a transient argument of the external unblock call, merge into that unsafe operation.
i is a plain loop counter inside LiquidityProtection_unblock.
_timestamp is the only input of the timestamp switch and feeds the block.timestamp dependency.
account is only the credited slot of _mint.
amount is the operand of the total supply arithmetic in _mint, merge into that unsafe operation.
account is only the debited slot of _burn.
amount is the operand of the burn balance arithmetic, merge into that unsafe operation.
accountBalance is the cached minuend of the burn subtraction, merge into that arithmetic unsafe operation.
